name: gizza-ai/xml-to-csv
summary: Flatten repeated XML elements into a CSV table.

tool.description: Convert XML into a CSV table: pick the repeated `record` element (e.g. <book> inside <catalog>) — auto-detected as the most frequent child of the root when omitted — and turn each one into a CSV row. Columns are inferred, in first-seen order, from the record's child element tags; nested elements flatten to dot-notation columns (<address><city> → 'address.city'). With attributes=true (default) each attribute also becomes a column ('@attr' on the record, 'path@attr' on a nested element). Repeated tags get .2/.3 suffixes, missing fields become empty cells, XML entities and CDATA are decoded, and values are CSV-quoted as needed. delimiter is a single char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe. Fully local and deterministic — no AI model.

record.description: The repeated element tag to treat as a row (e.g. 'book'). Leave empty to auto-detect the most frequent child of the root.

attributes.description: Include attributes as columns: '@attr' on the record element, 'child@attr' on a child. Default true.

delimiter.description: Field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.
